summary_en: This Phase I/Ib trial is testing cabozantinib given together with enfortumab vedotin in urothelial cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. Cabozantinib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28, and enfortumab vedotin is given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle, repeated while the disease does not progress and toxicity is not unacceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record says the study seeks the best dose and possible benefits and side effects, and it is a Phase I/Ib study.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase I/Ib está probando cabozantinib combinado con enfortumab vedotina en cáncer urotelial localmente avanzado o metastásico. El cabozantinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día los días 1 a 28, y la enfortumab vedotina se administra por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo de 28 días, que se repite mientras la enfermedad no progrese y la toxicidad no sea inaceptable. La medida de resultado principal no está indicada; el registro dice que el estudio busca la mejor dosis y los posibles beneficios y efectos secundarios, y que es un estudio de fase I/Ib.
who_for: Urothelial carcinoma confirmed by tissue examination, metastatic or unresectable locally advanced.
Prior treatment with a PD-1 or PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor, alone or in combination.
Prior platinum-containing chemotherapy, or not eligible for it at enrollment.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less, age 18 or older, and measurable disease by RECIST 1.1.
not_for: Prior enfortumab vedotin or other MMAE-based antibody-drug conjugate.
Known brain metastases unless adequately treated and stable.
Stroke, heart attack, or blood clot within 6 months, or uncontrolled high blood pressure.
Ongoing sensory or motor neuropathy grade 2 or higher, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: bladder urothelial carcinoma with squamous differentiation
